failure_boundary: POST /pulls rejected; the launcher's incompatible exception kwargs masked the HTTP error
interpretation: Repository permission blocks PR creation. No Wallet merge frontier reached. Original artifact remains authoritative.
next_attempt: Fresh workflow run only after the setting is confirmed. Do not replay the existing target.
provider_message: GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests.
required_external_action: Enable Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests in repository Settings > Actions > General > Workflow permissions.
